meaning: The assistant tells the user to run a command or perform a step themselves even though the assistant did not attempt that step in this turn. Do not match when a permission denial, sandbox or classifier refusal, tool refusal, or an action only the human can perform such as entering a password, granting OAuth consent, or using hardware came first. Do not match when the assistant actually attempted the requested command or step in this turn.
match: Please run: invoker-cli setup slack ... then tell me when it completes
Simulator build still passes. Now on your end in Xcode:
Run the bash script on your machine and let me know what it prints
not_match: Permission denied by the sandbox, so only you can authorize this command.
OAuth consent is required in your browser; I cannot click the consent button for you.
I ran invoker-cli setup slack and it failed with the following output.
Please enter your password when prompted; I cannot see or type it.
on_hit: Hand-back needs an attempt: perform the command or step first, or state the concrete permission refusal or human-only boundary that prevents it. Do not hand the work back without that evidence.
